wan.intro: A collectible vinyl toy monster figure stands on a plain light-grey studio background.
wan.lock: The toy stays on the same spot and ends in exactly the same pose as it started. Static shot, fixed camera, no zoom, no pan, no cut. The plain light-grey background and the soft even lighting do not change.
wan.lock_assemble: Static shot, fixed camera, no zoom, no pan, no cut. The plain light-grey background and the soft even lighting do not change.

wan.intro_assemble: The separate parts of a collectible vinyl toy monster figure lie apart on a plain light-grey studio background.

ltx.intro: Static frame. Stop-motion style toy animation of a collectible vinyl toy monster figure standing on a seamless light-grey studio background in soft even light.
ltx.lock: The camera is locked off and never moves or zooms, the background stays plain and empty, and the toy ends in exactly the same pose as it started.
ltx.lock_assemble: The camera is locked off and never moves or zooms, and the background stays plain and empty.
ltx.negative: shaky, glitchy, low quality, worst quality, deformed, distorted, disfigured, motion smear, motion artifacts, morphing, melting, extra limbs, camera movement, zoom, cut, transition, text, music, speech
ltx.intro_assemble: Static frame. Stop-motion style toy animation: the separate parts of a collectible vinyl toy monster figure lie apart on a seamless light-grey studio background in soft even light.

rigid: Its parts are rigid plastic pieces that rotate at their ball joints like a stop-motion toy; they never bend, stretch, melt or change shape, and no new parts appear.

scope.part: Only that part moves; the rest of the toy stays still.
scope.body: The whole toy moves together and keeps its shape.

roar.motion: The toy tilts its {part} back, opens its mouth wide and lets out a roar while the head shakes slightly, then closes its mouth and lowers the head back.

howl.motion: The toy lifts its {part} to point straight up, opens its mouth and howls, then lowers the head back.

chomp.sound: two hollow plastic clacks of teeth
chomp.motion: The toy leans its {part} forward and snaps its jaws open and shut twice, then pulls the head back.

headspin.sound: a ratcheting plastic click as the head turns
headspin.motion: The toy turns its {part} smoothly all the way around in one full circle on the neck joint, blinks once, and faces forward again.

headbutt.motion: The toy lowers its {part}, thrusts it forward in one quick butt, then lifts the head back up.

scan.motion: The toy turns its {part} slowly to the left and then to the right while its big eyes flicker with light, then faces forward again.

hide.sound: a hollow plastic clunk, then a pop
hide.motion: The toy pulls its head, arms and legs in toward its {part} until they are tucked tightly against the body, holds for a moment, then pops them back out.

puff.sound: a deep breath in and a long breath out
puff.motion: The toy leans back and pushes its {part} proudly forward and up as if taking a huge breath, holds for a moment, then relaxes back.

wobble.motion: The toy rocks its {part} from side to side three times like a wobbling toy, then settles upright.

snap.motion: The toy raises both {part} in front of its chest and snaps them open and shut twice, then lowers them back to its sides.

slash.motion: The toy raises both {part} and swipes them downward one after the other in two quick slashes, then lowers them back to its sides.

drill.motion: The toy points both {part} forward and the drill bits spin fast for a moment, then stop, and the arms lower back to its sides.

clap.motion: The toy brings both {part} together in front of its belly and claps them three times, then lowers them back to its sides.

pound.sound: four hollow drum thumps on plastic
pound.motion: The toy raises both {part} and drums its fists on its chest four times, then lowers them back to its sides.

hop.sound: a springy boing and a plastic thud on landing
hop.motion: The toy crouches on its {part}, springs straight up into the air in one hop, lands on the same spot with a small bounce, and stands still again.

stomp.motion: The toy lifts one of its {part} and stomps it down, then does the same with the other, and stands still again.

roll.sound: a small toy motor hum and rattling treads
roll.motion: The toy rolls a short way forward on its {part} with the treads turning, then rolls back to exactly where it started and stops.

scuttle.motion: The toy takes three quick small steps to the side on its {part}, then three quick steps back to exactly where it started.

whip.sound: a whoosh and a sharp snap
whip.motion: The toy swings its {part} out to one side and cracks it like a whip, then lets it settle back behind the body.

sting.sound: a quick whoosh and a tiny ping
sting.motion: The toy curls its {part} up over its shoulder and jabs the stinger forward once, then curls it back behind the body.

smash.motion: The toy lifts its {part} high and slams the club down on the ground behind it, then lifts it back to where it was.

fan.sound: a soft rustle like a paper fan opening
fan.motion: The toy folds its {part} halfway closed, then spreads it wide open again into a full fan and shimmers the feathers.

wag.motion: The toy wags its {part} quickly from side to side four times, then lets it settle back behind the body.

splash.motion: The toy lifts its {part} and slaps it down flat on the ground twice, then lifts it back to where it was.

hover.motion: The toy beats its {part} very fast, rises a little off the ground and hovers for a moment, then sinks back down onto the same spot and the wings stop.

flap.motion: The toy flaps its {part} down and up three times in big slow beats, then holds them open as before.

charge.sound: a short rumble and a thud
charge.motion: The toy leans forward to point its {part} ahead, makes one short charging lunge forward, then steps back to exactly where it started and straightens up.

slice.motion: The toy leans to the left and then to the right so that its {part} sweeps through the air like a fin cutting water, then straightens up.

beam.motion: The dish of its {part} spins around twice while its little light blinks, then stops in the starting position.

bristle.motion: The toy shivers and its {part} flare outward and sparkle, then settle back to how they were.

idle.label: klid (smyčka)
idle.sound: quiet room tone and a faint plastic creak
idle.motion: The toy stands in place and breathes gently: its body rises and falls slightly, it blinks once and its tail sways a little. Nothing else happens.

cheer.label: radost
cheer.sound: a happy little squeak and a plastic thud on landing
cheer.motion: The toy throws both arms up, does one small happy hop on the spot with its mouth open in a cheer, lands, and lowers its arms back to its sides.

assemble.label: sestava
assemble.sound: a series of satisfying plastic clicks as each part snaps on
assemble.motion: The loose parts slide toward the body one after another and snap onto their ball joints: first the legs, then the arms, the tail, the back attachment and finally the head. The finished toy stands upright in its final pose and holds still.

part_fx.head_dragon: A small puff of grey smoke drifts from its nostrils.
part_fx.torso_dragon: The orange belly plate glows brighter while it holds the pose.
part_fx.torso_shadow_dragon: The violet belly plate glows brighter while it holds the pose.
part_fx.torso_stegosaurus: The plates along its back stand up straighter while it holds the pose.
part_fx.back_phoenix: Small orange flames flicker around its feet during the jump.
part_fx.front_trex: The arms are comically short, so the slashes are tiny.

rigid_assemble: The parts are rigid plastic pieces; they never bend, stretch, melt or change shape, and no new parts appear.
